{{Quote|I am Lord Vacuus. The conqueror of Begeren. The killer of Garatak the Singed.|Vacuus encountering the Wrath|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vacuus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived centuries before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Vacuus' spirit possessed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] that ventured in the [[Dark Temple]]. He and his Sith minions were on the search for the [[Ravager (device)|Ravager]]. Vacuus was hoping to find it and use it to exact his revenge on a contemporary [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], Lord [[Pharshol]]. However, his luck turned down when [[Darth Baras]] sent [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to find the Ravager. Vacuus engaged the apprentice in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel, but was overwhelmed and defeated.
